methodology.population: Dated estimates only. No interpolation or extrapolation. Future UN projections excluded.
methodology.historicalCoverage: Sparse and geographically uneven; prominence is among available estimates, not a proven complete global ranking.
methodology.geographicReliability: Reba 1–3 scores concern geocoded identification, not accuracy of population estimates.
methodology.identityAlignment: Exact normalized name/recorded alias plus reference points <=50 km; ambiguous candidates remain separate. Modern urban-centre definitions do not imply ancient territorial continuity.
methodology.capitalPolicy: UN capital indicator is not imported as a historical capital assertion. Dated capitals are compiled separately.
methodology.timelineAppearance: First available evidence is not a founding date; loss of recent evidence is not abandonment.
methodology.modernSampling: UN annual estimates are sampled at five-year checkpoints plus each city’s first and final available estimate through 2025. Raw annual workbook retained.
